### Approach
The approach to solve this problem involves using a hash map (dictionary) to keep track of the numbers we have encountered as we iterate through the array. For each number, we calculate its complement (the difference between the target and the current number). If this complement exists in our hash map, it means we have already encountered a number that, when added to the current number, equals the target. We then return the indices of these two numbers. If the complement is not found, we add the current number and its index to the hash map and continue iterating.
